title: Security and data
description: Where implesta stores your data, who can see what, and how every change is recorded. The page to forward to your finance and IT leads.
teaser: Hosting, access by role, audit log and GDPR.
h1: Your data, who sees it, and what is recorded
lead: The facts your finance and IT leads will ask for, in one place.

items.value: Each customer's data lives in its own database, separate from every other customer's.
What each person can see and change follows their role. Financial data, such as rates, margins and invoice amounts, is only visible to people with finance access.
Every change to clients, contacts, deals, proposals, invoices and profiles is recorded in a log that can't be edited, and can be exported as CSV.
Each signature records the signer's name, title, email, time and a checksum of the signed document.
Clients review proposals, follow projects and approve hours through secure links, without an account in your workspace.
Email and password. [[Publish once it ships: two-factor authentication through an authenticator app, required for administrators.]]
[[Publish once configured: backed up every night and kept for 14 days, with point-in-time recovery for the last 7 days, stored in the EU.]]
An administrator can export all your data at any time. We delete it within 30 days after the contract ends, and it disappears from backups when they expire.
If a security incident affects your data, we tell you without undue delay, and within 72 hours.
Our code, the libraries it uses and our cloud setup are scanned continuously by Aikido Security.
implesta is not ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified yet. Ask us how we work in the meantime; we walk you through it.
Our [data processing agreement](page:dpa) is part of every contract. It lists our subprocessors and the security measures we take.

final.text: Bring them to the demo. {minutes} minutes with {founder}.
